requirements.statement: The Governova engine shall govern a repository that does not contain the engine's own source tree.
requirements.source: ADR-005 — platform architecture; discovered as a defect in #113 and closed by #127
requirements.acceptance: A wheel installed into a clean environment runs against a directory holding no constitution/ and no .git, and reports on it.

requirements.statement: A Governova check shall report unknown when it cannot determine whether a standard is satisfied.
requirements.source: ADR-006 — engine security posture; the standing rule governing every evidence tier
requirements.acceptance: A probe, analyser, or tier-0 requirements read that lacks the information to answer returns unknown, never satisfied and never violated.

requirements.statement: The relay shall refuse an L4 approval request from any non-human actor at the API boundary.
requirements.source: ADR-005 — permission model; S10.8. Exercised live and recorded at seq 4 of the audit chain
requirements.acceptance: A non-human actor requesting L4 is refused, and the refusal is recorded as a SEV1 violation rather than discarded.

requirements.statement: The compiler shall produce a byte-identical constitutional index from unchanged source markdown.
requirements.source: ADR-005 — the compiled index as the single machine-readable contract
requirements.acceptance: Two compile runs over the same source yield the same content checksum, on any platform and independent of line endings.

requirements.statement: The audit trail shall link each record to its predecessor with a hash that detects any later edit.
requirements.source: ADR-005 — governance runtime; the property the tamper-evident design exists to provide
requirements.acceptance: Altering or removing any record breaks verification of the chain from that point onward.

requirements.statement: Every deterministic detection rule shall bind an anti-pattern that exists in the compiled constitution.
requirements.source: ADR-005 — rule engine governance; prevents the rule set drifting from the corpus
requirements.acceptance: Validation of the rule set against the compiled index returns no unbound anti-pattern.

requirements.statement: The supply-chain gate shall reject a dependency whose licence is absent from the allowlist.
requirements.source: S8.85 — ratified 2026-06-21; the gate found a live CVE on its first run
requirements.acceptance: A dependency carrying an unknown or copyleft licence fails the gate unless a recorded exception names it.

requirements.statement: An advisory-tier check shall leave the build result unchanged regardless of what it finds.
requirements.source: ADR-005 — detection tiers; an advisory tier that blocks on a typo'd secret is a worse product
requirements.acceptance: Advisory findings are reported and the process exit status is unaffected by their presence or count.
